Based on my search, I can provide you with information about **CFA Institute membership** and related fees for 2026.

## CFA Institute Membership Overview

CFA Institute offers different types of membership:

### 1. **Membership Types**

| Membership Type | Requirements | Benefits |
|----------------|------------|----------|
| **Regular Membership** | Bachelor's degree + 4,000 hours of relevant work experience (36+ months) + passed Level I CFA Exam | Required for CFA charter; voting rights; full access to research, learning content, member directory, volunteer opportunities |
| **Affiliate Membership** | Passed Level I CFA Exam only | Access to research, learning content, member directory, volunteer opportunities (no voting rights) |

### 2. **2026 CFA Institute Membership Fees**

| Component | Cost (USD) |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Annual Regular/Affiliate Membership Dues** | $299/year |
| **Professional Leave Membership** | $100/year |

**Important note:** CFA Institute dues are discounted for certain countries, including members residing in India.

### 3. **CFA Society India Membership Fees**

| Component | Cost |
|-----------|------|
| **Regular & Affiliate Annual Dues** | INR 5,000 + 18% GST |
| **Professional Leave** | INR 2,000 + 18% GST |

CFA Society India now collects membership dues in local currency (INR). The membership year runs from **July 1 to June 30**.

### 4. **Key Requirements for CFA Charter**

To earn and maintain the CFA charter, you must:
- Pass all three levels of the CFA exam
- Complete 4,000 hours of investment-related work experience over minimum 36 months
- Obtain professional references (2 if one is an active regular member of CFA Society India; 3 if none are)
- Apply for and maintain **Regular Membership** with CFA Institute
- Join a local CFA Society (required for CFA Institute membership application)

### 5. **2026 CFA Exam Registration Fees (for context)**

| Level | Early Registration | Standard Registration |
|-------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Level I & II | $1,140 | $1,490 |
| Level III | $1,240 | $1,590 |

**Note:** The one-time $350 enrollment fee was abolished starting February 2026.

### 6. **Total Estimated Costs**

| Scenario | Estimated Total Cost |
|----------|---------------------|
| Minimum (early registration, no retakes, no prep materials) | ~$3,570-$3,860 |
| Realistic (includes prep materials, possible retake) | $7,000-$9,500 |
| Maximum (multiple retakes, premium materials) | $12,000+ |

### 7. **Ongoing Costs After Earning Charter**

- **CFA Institute Annual Membership:** $299/year (required to maintain charter and use CFA designation)
- **Local Society Dues:** Varies by region (e.g., CFA Society India: INR 5,000 + GST)

If you stop paying membership dues, your membership lapses and you lose the right to use the CFA designation, though you can reactivate by paying back dues.

---

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://www.tradingcore.com.br/cfa/cfa-exam-cost-2026
6. https://corpready.in/resources/articles/146-cfa-course-details-india.html
7. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
